items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
items.translation: 指示某些其他对象是否“等于”当前对象。如果另一个对象属于同一类，且所有记录组件均相等，则这两个对象相等。本记录类中的所有组件均使用 Objects::equals(Object,Object) 进行比较。

items.source: model - The model used for generating the response.
items.translation: model - 用于生成响应的模型。

items.source: createdAt - The timestamp of the response generation.
items.translation: createdAt - 响应生成的时间戳。

items.source: doneReason - The reason the model stopped generating text.
items.translation: doneReason - 模型停止生成文本的原因。

items.source: done - Whether this is the final response. For streaming response only the last message is marked as done. If true, this response may be followed by another response with the following, additional fields: context, prompt_eval_count, prompt_eval_duration, eval_count, eval_duration.
items.translation: done - 表示这是否为最终响应。对于流式响应，仅最后一条消息被标记为 done。如果为 true，此响应之后可能会跟随另一个包含以下附加字段的响应：context、prompt_eval_count、prompt_eval_duration、eval_count、eval_duration。

items.source: totalDuration - Time spent generating the response.
items.translation: totalDuration - 生成响应所花费的时间。

items.source: loadDuration - Time spent loading the model.
items.translation: loadDuration - 加载模型所花费的时间。

items.source: promptEvalCount - Number of tokens in the prompt.
items.translation: promptEvalCount - 提示词中的 token 数量。

items.source: promptEvalDuration - Time spent evaluating the prompt.
items.translation: promptEvalDuration - 评估提示词所花费的时间。

items.source: evalCount - Number of tokens in the response.
items.translation: evalCount - 响应中的 token 数量。

items.source: evalDuration - Time spent generating the response.
items.translation: evalDuration - 生成响应所花费的时间。
